requirements.quote: Manufacture at the disclosed ISO 9001:2015 certified site. Identify all PCB, assembly, enclosure and test subcontractors; no site transfer without written approval.
requirements.text: Manufacture at ISO 9001:2015 certified site, disclose subcontractors, and obtain approval for site transfers.

requirements.quote: Use IPC-A-610 and J-STD-001 Class 2 workmanship; build rigid PCBs to IPC-6012 Class 2. Apply an IEC 61340-5-1 ESD programme and J-STD-033 moisture controls.
requirements.text: Follow specified standards for workmanship, PCB building, ESD, and moisture controls.

requirements.quote: Use only new, authentic components from OEMs or authorised distributors. Broker purchases, recovered parts and substitutions require advance approval and a risk-based verification plan.
requirements.text: Use authentic components; get approval for non-standard parts and provide a verification plan.

requirements.quote: Track material by manufacturer part number, lot/date code and board lot; link finished serials to PCB serials, software hash, fixture revision and all test results.
requirements.text: Track materials and link finished products to their components and test results.

requirements.quote: Inspect all SMT assemblies by AOI; use X-ray for all hidden-joint packages. Validate ICT or flying-probe coverage; record uncovered nets and compensating functional tests.
requirements.text: Inspect SMT assemblies with AOI and X-ray, validate test coverage, and document uncovered nets.

requirements.quote: Maintain qualified alternate sources for supply-critical parts where technically feasible. Report single-source parts, lead times, MOQ, lifecycle status and recovery options each month.
requirements.text: Maintain alternate sources for critical parts and report on single-source parts monthly.

requirements.quote: Buyer will issue a rolling 26-week forecast, updated monthly. Weeks 1-8 become firm only when covered by a PO; weeks 9-16 are material-planning signals and weeks 17-26 are indicative.
requirements.text: Follow the buyer's 26-week rolling forecast for material planning.

requirements.quote: Non-cancellable/non-returnable (NCNR) or long-lead purchases require an itemised, capped written authorisation before commitment.
requirements.text: Obtain written authorization for NCNR or long-lead purchases.

requirements.quote: Quote a two-week finished-goods buffer at the applicable monthly rate and identify carrying cost within the unit price.
requirements.text: Provide a two-week finished-goods buffer and include carrying costs in the unit price.

requirements.quote: Provide an alternate-line recovery plan with an eight-week recovery objective, backed-up tooling/test software and a critical supplier map.
requirements.text: Provide a recovery plan with an eight-week objective and supporting resources.

requirements.quote: Comply with applicable labour, environmental and anti-bribery law; maintain material declarations and conflict-minerals reporting where requested.
requirements.text: Comply with legal and ethical standards and provide required declarations.

requirements.quote: Report supply interruptions within two business days.
requirements.text: Notify of supply interruptions within two business days.

requirements.quote: Submit a product/process change notice at least 90 days before a proposed change and end-of-life notice at least 12 months before last-time buy, or within five business days of a shorter OEM notice.
requirements.text: Provide advance notice for product/process changes and end-of-life events.

requirements.quote: Include fit/function, regulatory, cost and schedule impacts plus requalification evidence.
requirements.text: Include detailed impacts and evidence in change notices.
